title: Less than perfect quality but nice finished look.
text: Less than perfect quality but nice finished look.. I like the finished look. It’s sleek and accommodating to different sized photos. However, I had difficulty when assembling because the frame part kept coming apart. Not good, poor quality.

product_metadata.title: 11x11 Black Gallery Floating Picture Frame - Includes Both Attached Hanging Hardware - Clear Glass Display for Photos 4x4, 8x8, up to 11 by 11
features: CLASSIC GALLERY DESIGN: This 11x11 inch black floating picture frame features an elegant European design that will help accent any home or office. Frames includes attached hanging hardware for easy display right out of the box.

TOP QUALITY MATERIALS: With a smooth black finish and two panels of thick glass, this frame is built to last so your photos can hang beautifully for years. This frame has features others don't including custom made turn buttons on back to easily swap pictures and attached hardware to easily hang your photos up.

TURN YOUR PHOTO INTO ART: This floating frame features unlimited options - you can use the included art to hang on your wall, or use an 11x11 photo or any combination of smaller photos (we recommend between 4x4 and 8x8 for the best floating effect) to display your favorite memories.

EASY TO USE: Our frame comes with hanging hardware installed on the frame, so your picture can be up on the wall in minutes. These floating frames also have custom made turn buttons to painlessly swap out photos unlike the tabs most other frames use.

GREAT GIFT IDEA: All Smashed Banana frames come in a ready-to-gift white box, perfect to give on any holiday or special occasion. We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all of our products, and take great pride in offering fun, high quality gift ideas for your home and decor needs!
